scientific_question: Does fixed biological MaleCNS recurrent topology provide a more useful internal state for ARC-AGI-3 interaction than matched topology controls under an identical engineered interface?

variants.rewire: exact directed in/out-degree preserving target-swap null
variants.random: same node count, edge count, weight multiset, and sign multiset with random directed non-self topology
variants.stateless: same state size and input projection with recurrence removed

claim_boundaries: A game win does not mean a fruit fly understands ARC or abstract reasoning.
ARC frame encoding and action semantics are engineered interfaces.
Reservoir states are modeled neural activity, not measured neural recordings.
The policy head is engineered learning and must not be described as a natural fly motor decoder.
A single hero run cannot establish topology advantage.
Any topology advantage requires repeated seeds and matched nulls.
next_confirmatory_requirement: freeze a multi-seed, multi-game evaluation manifest before inspecting topology-level performance
